title: PASSAGES: The Discovery of a Strongly Lensed Protocluster Core Candidate at Cosmic Noon
summary: Investigating the processes by which galaxies rapidly build up their stellar mass during the peak of their star formation ($z=2-3$) is crucial to advancing our understanding of the assembly of large-scale structures. We report the discovery of one of the most gas- and dust-rich protocluster core candidates, PJ0846+15 (J0846), from the Planck All-Sky Survey to Analyze Gravitationally lensed Extreme Starbursts (PASSAGES) sample. The exceedingly high total star formation rate (SFR) uncorrected for lensing magnification ($μ$) of $μ\text{SFR} = 39900^{+23000}_{-12900} \text{ M}_\odot\text{ yr}^{-1}$ is the result of a foreground cluster lensing at least 11 dusty star-forming galaxies between $z=2.660-2.669$, where the intrinsic value is estimated to be $\text{SFR} = 5200^{+3200}_{-2000} \text{ M}_\odot\text{ yr}^{-1}$. Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) observations uncovered 18 CO(3--2) emission-line detections, some of which are multiply-imaged systems, lensed by a foreground cluster at $z=0.77$. We present the first multi-wavelength characterization of this field, constructing a lens model that predicts that these 11 galaxies ($μ\simeq 1.5-25$) are contained within a projected physical extent of $280 \times 150 \text{ kpc}$, with a velocity dispersion of $σ_{v} = 246 \pm 72 \text{ km s}^{-1}$. J0846 exhibits the rare case of a protocluster candidate whose core is strongly-lensed, offering a magnified view of the rapid stellar buildup within an overdense environment at Cosmic Noon.

title: Deciphering The Launching of Multi-phase AGN-driven Outflows and Their (Spatially Resolved) Multi-scale Impact
comment: updated in accordance with the published version
summary: Beyond deepening our understanding of the formation, growth, and evolution of supermassive black holes, it is crucial to uncover the role of feeding and feedback processes from growing black holes (i.e., active galactic nucleus; AGN) in shaping the cosmic ecosystem. Such studies include understanding the dynamics of gas flows in the interstellar (ISM), circumgalactic (CGM), intracluster (ICM), and intergalactic media (IGM). As the output of a sub-group in Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO) AGN Working Group, this Science Case Development Document (SCDD) proposes to use future HWO observations to solve the following questions. Which mechanism is dominant in triggering inflows/outflows through feedback? How is AGN activity triggered, and is it associated with circumnuclear star formation and what is the overall effect of AGN feedback on star formation (SF)? In AGN feedback, which mode is more influential and does AGN feedback operate similarly or differently in the local universe and at high redshift? To answer these questions, this SCDD proposes to use potential HWO observations as follows. Resolve and characterize the spatial distribution of ionized and cold/warm molecular gas, especially those in inflows/outflows; Explore the spatial coupling and potential stratification of multi-phase inflows/outflows on different physical scales and their resolved and global correlations with AGN and/or SF activities; Investigate whether corresponding outflows/jets induce shocks and/or fluctuations that trigger or suppress the formation of molecular clouds and hence new stars. Specifically, HWO's capabilities will enable us to achieve the above scientific goals while existing facilities lack the required combination of high-throughput ultraviolet (UV) and near-infrared (NIR) integral field unit (IFU) capabilities with simultaneously sufficient spatial resolution and sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文是HWO AGN工作组子组的科学案例开发文件，提出利用未来HWO的高通量UV/NIR积分场观测，研究AGN的吸积与反馈过程如何通过多相气体流入/流出塑造星系及宇宙生态系统。
AI.motivation: 除深化对超大质量黑洞形成、增长与演化的理解外，还需揭示成长中的黑洞（AGN）的吸积（feeding）与反馈（feedback）过程在塑造宇宙生态系统中的作用，包括理解星际介质、环星系介质、星系团内介质和星系际介质中的气体动力学。现有设施缺乏所需的高通量UV与NIR积分场能力，以及足够空间分辨率与灵敏度的组合，因此需要未来HWO观测。
AI.method: 提出利用HWO观测：分辨并表征电离气体与冷/暖分子气体的空间分布，尤其是流入/流出气体；探索不同物理尺度上多相流入/流出的空间耦合与潜在分层，及其与AGN和/或恒星形成活动的分辨与全局相关性；研究相应的流出/喷流是否引发激波和/或涨落，从而触发或抑制分子云及新恒星的形成。
AI.result: 作为科学案例开发文件，尚未给出观测结果；其核心论点是HWO的高通量UV和NIR积分场（IFU）能力，结合足够的空间分辨率和灵敏度，可实现上述科学目标，而现有设施不具备这一能力组合。
AI.conclusion: 该SCDD提出用未来HWO观测回答若干关键问题：何种机制主导触发通过反馈产生的流入/流出？AGN活动如何被触发，是否与核周恒星形成相关，AGN反馈对恒星形成的总体效应如何？在AGN反馈中哪种模式更具影响，以及AGN反馈在本地宇宙与高红移是否表现相似或不同？

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Illustration of gas flows within galaxies, driven by both gravitational forces and feedback processes. AGN feedback, through jets and winds, plays a critical role in regulating these flows, impacting gas cooling, star formation, and the redistribution of material across the interstellar, circumgalactic, intracluster, and intergalactic media. This dynamic interaction is essential for understanding the lifecycle of galaxies and the broader cosmic ecosystem. Figure source: HABEX Report, The Habitable Exoplanet Observatory Study Team (see also Astro2020 ).
figures.caption_zh: 图1：星系内气流的示意图，由引力和反馈过程驱动。AGN反馈通过喷流和风，在调节这些气流中起着关键作用，影响气体冷却、恒星形成以及物质在星际介质、环星系介质、星系团内介质和星系际介质中的重新分布。这种动态相互作用对于理解星系的生命周期和更广泛的宇宙生态系统至关重要。图源：HABEX报告，宜居系外行星天文台研究团队（另见Astro2020）。

title: Evidence for Enhancement in the Rate of Fast Radio Bursts Toward Galaxy Clusters
comment: 31 Pages (8 Appendix) 17 Figures, submitted to ApJ
summary: Massive galaxy clusters can introduce gravitational lensing and populations of suppressed star formation member galaxies into the line of sight, potentially changing the distribution of observable sources toward them from that of the average sky. As a result, Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) aligned with galaxy clusters can provide a unique window into parameter spaces of the FRB population that other lines of sight do not afford. In this study, we demonstrate that the second CHIME/FRB baseband catalog contains FRBs emitted from within or behind clusters identified from the latest DECaLS data release; we isolate a sample of 26 FRBs where this is likely, including one repeating FRB and two FRBs that intersect the Coma cluster. Comparing our results against a range of simulated FRB populations, we conclude that the number of these associations represents a $3σ$ rate enhancement toward galaxy clusters, constituting $1.4\pm0.4\%$ of the FRBs detected in the second CHIME/FRB baseband catalog. We suggest that this enhancement is caused by an equal proportion of member galaxies hosting additional FRBs, and gravitational lensing magnifying background sources. We demonstrate that such contributions are sensitive to alternative progenitor channels and high redshift evolution in the FRB population, providing a future avenue for constraining these features. Considering the redshifts and masses of the associated clusters, we identify FRB 20211113A, which is aligned with the strong gravitational lens Abell 2218 as a potential lensed candidate for further consideration.

Left: These distributions under variation in the slope of the power-law FRB energy function \(\gamma=0\) , \(\gamma=-0.5\) , \(\gamma=-1\) . title: Magnetic fields in extreme primordial halos: turbulent collapse and implications for early quasar formation
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in A&A
summary: It is sometimes suggested that the most massive quasars at high redshift may have formed from rare high-sigma peaks in the cosmic density field. We explore here the evolution in a massive primordial halo corresponding to one of these rare sigma peaks, employing cosmological high-resolution magneto-hydrodynamical zoom-in simulations with initial field strength of $10^{-14}-10^{-8}$ G. The dark matter halo forms at the intersection of strongly convergent flows, leading to the formation of highly supersonic turbulence already on intergalactic scales, with turbulent Mach numbers of order $10-20$ also within the halo. Turbulent magnetic field amplification has never been explored in this regime and we therefore investigate whether this gives rise to effects similar to those observed in more typical halos. While the weaker initial field is somewhat more strongly amplified as a result of the shear flows, overall the evolution in the different simulations is rather similar and the flows are dominated by supersonic turbulence. We show in particular that the turbulent Jeans mass always dominates over the thermal and magnetic Jeans masses, and only on scales of $10^{-2}-10$ pc, the magnetic Jeans mass may become comparable to the thermal one. Our simulations thus strongly suggest the evolution to be dominated by the large-scale dynamics. As established in previous work, we thus expect the formation of central massive objects of a few times $10^4$ M$_\odot$ also in the presence of magnetic fields. The situation is somewhat different from more typical atomic cooling halos, where previous results have indicated a larger relevance of the magnetic Jeans mass on intermediate scales, potentially enhancing the mass of the massive object.

AI.tldr: 本文通过宇宙学高分辨率磁流体力学zoom-in模拟，研究高红移大质量类星体可能起源于宇宙密度场中稀有高σ峰的演化。结果表明，超音速湍流主导系统演化，湍流金斯质量始终超过热和磁金斯质量，因此预计仍会形成约几×10^4 M_⊙的中心大质量天体，且整体演化受大尺度动力学主导。
AI.motivation: 有观点认为高红移最庞大的类星体可能形成于宇宙密度场中稀有的高σ峰。本文旨在探究这类稀有峰对应的原初大质量晕中，湍流磁场放大及磁金斯质量等效应如何影响其演化，并与更典型的晕进行对比。
AI.method: 采用宇宙学高分辨率磁流体力学zoom-in模拟，针对一个对应稀有σ峰的大质量原初晕开展研究，初始磁场强度设定为10^{-14}–10^{-8} G，考察暗物质晕形成过程、湍流马赫数以及磁场放大效应。
AI.result: 暗物质晕形成于强汇聚流交汇处，在星系际尺度上即产生高度超音速湍流，晕内湍流马赫数约为10–20。较弱初始磁场因剪切流作用被略强放大，但各模拟整体演化相似，湍流主导。湍流金斯质量始终压倒热金斯质量和磁金斯质量；仅在10^{-2}–10 pc尺度上，磁金斯质量才可能与热金斯质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 模拟强烈表明系统演化由大尺度动力学主导，因此在存在磁场的情况下仍预期形成约几×10^4 M_⊙的中心大质量天体。这一情形与更典型的原子冷却晕有所不同——后者先前结果表明磁金斯质量在中等尺度上更为重要，可能增大中心大质量天体的质量。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 有时人们认为，高红移处质量最大的类星体可能由宇宙密度场中罕见的高sigma峰形成。我们在此探索一个对应于这些罕见sigma峰之一的大质量原初晕中的演化，采用宇宙学高分辨率磁流体动力学zoom-in模拟，初始场强为 $10^{-14}-10^{-8}$ G。暗物质晕形成于强汇聚流的交汇处，导致在星系际尺度上就已形成高度超声速湍流，晕内湍流马赫数也达到 $10-20$ 量级。湍流磁场放大从未在这一区域被探索过，因此我们研究这是否会产生与更典型晕中观测到的类似效应。虽然较弱的初始场由于剪切流而被稍强地放大，但总体而言不同模拟中的演化相当相似，且流动由超声速湍流主导。我们特别表明，湍流金斯质量始终主导于热金斯质量和磁金斯质量，只有在 $10^{-2}-10$ pc 的尺度上，磁金斯质量才可能与热金斯质量相当。因此我们的模拟强烈表明演化由大尺度动力学主导。正如先前工作所确立的，我们因此预期在存在磁场的情况下也会形成几倍 $10^4$ M$_\odot$ 的中心大质量天体。这一情形与更典型的原子冷却晕有所不同，后者先前结果表明磁金斯质量在中等尺度上更为重要，可能增大中心大质量天体的质量。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 模拟强烈表明系统演化由大尺度动力学主导，因此在存在磁场的情况下仍预期形成约几×10^4 M_⊙的中心大质量天体。这一情形与更典型的原子冷却晕有所不同——后者先前结果表明磁金斯质量在中等尺度上更为重要，可能增大中心大质量天体的质量。（基于可用摘要）

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Properties of the simulated halos shortly after the onset of collapse, when reaching a peak density of \(\sim 3\times 10^{-15}\) g cm -3 . Listed are the initial magnetic field seed strength \(B_{0}\) in proper units, the gas mass \(M_{{gas}}\) , the total halo mass \(M_{{total}}\) enclosed within the virial radius \(R_{{vir}}\approx 0.455\) kpc, the thermal Jeans mass \(M_{J,th}\) evaluated at \(R_{{vir}}\) , the normalized mass-to-flux ratio \(\mu\) , the spin parameter, and the redshift \(z\) .
figures.caption_zh: 表1：模拟晕在坍缩开始后不久、达到峰值密度 \(\sim 3\times 10^{-15}\) g cm -3 时的性质。列出的是以固有单位表示的初始磁场种子强度 \(B_{0}\)、气体质量 \(M_{{gas}}\)、包含在维里半径 \(R_{{vir}}\approx 0.455\) kpc 内的总晕质量 \(M_{{total}}\)、在 \(R_{{vir}}\) 处评估的热金斯质量 \(M_{J,th}\)、归一化质通量比 \(\mu\)、自旋参数以及红移 \(z\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Density-weighted projections of the density along the y-axis at four different spatial scales. From top to bottom the physical width was varied using 100, 10, 1 and 0.1 pc, and from left to right we varied the initial magnetic field strength to \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). All projections correspond to the final evolutionary stage i.e. when the halo reaches a peak density of \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Times are indicated in the bottom left of each panel, and magnetic field lines are colour-coded from cyan to magenta with increasing field strength. The overall density morphology and the characteristic four cold stream pattern remain mostly unaffected by \(B_{0}\) on large scales. Differences only appear at smaller scales, where the strongest field case develops two distinct cores.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：沿y轴在四个不同空间尺度上的密度加权密度投影。从上到下，物理宽度分别使用100、10、1和0.1 pc，从左到右我们将初始磁场强度变化为 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\) 和 \(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有）。所有投影对应于最终演化阶段，即当晕达到峰值密度 \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) 时。时间标注在每个面板的左下角，磁力线从青色到品红色按场强增加着色。总体密度形态和特征性的四条冷流模式在大尺度上基本不受 \(B_{0}\) 影响。差异仅出现在较小尺度上，其中最强场情况发展出两个不同的核心。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of density and temperature when reaching a peak density of \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Black, pink and purple lines are for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper), respectively. The density profile closely follows an isothermal collapse profile, while the temperature profile show the expected H 2 dominated cooling below \(10\) pc. This occurs for all three initial magnetic field strengths.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：达到峰值密度 \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) 时的质量加权球面分箱径向密度和温度剖面。黑、粉和紫色线分别对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\) 和 \(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有）的运行。密度剖面紧密遵循等温坍缩剖面，而温度剖面显示在 \(10\) pc 以下预期的 H 2 主导冷却。这在所有三个初始磁场强度下均发生。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of radial velocity, turbulent velocity, sonic Mach number, turbulent Mach number, mass accretion rate for the halo when reaching three different peak densities. Black lines are for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G] (proper), pink lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G] (proper), and purple lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). Solid lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) , dashed lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) and dotted lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . The physical properties of the halo show no significant dependence on \(B_{0}\) , demonstrating that the collapse dynamics are dominated by the highly supersonic turbulence ( \(\mathcal{M}\sim 30-60\) ) driven by the converging cold streams.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：晕达到三个不同峰值密度时的质量加权球面分箱径向速度、湍流速度、声速马赫数、湍流马赫数、质量吸积率径向剖面。黑线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G]（固有）的运行，粉线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G]（固有）的运行，紫线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]（固有）的运行。实线对应 \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，虚线对应 \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，点线对应 \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)。晕的物理性质对 \(B_{0}\) 没有显著依赖，表明坍缩动力学由汇聚冷流驱动的高度超声速湍流（ \(\mathcal{M}\sim 30-60\) ）主导。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Density-weighted projections of the density along the x-axis with a physical width of \(0.02\) pc. From left to right we varied the initial magnetic field strength to \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). All projections correspond to the final evolutionary stage i.e. when the halo reaches a peak density of \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Times are indicated in the bottom left of each panel, and magnetic field lines are shown in magenta. Disc-like structures are present at sub-pc scales, with the strongest initial magnetic field case showing the clearest disc-like features. The morphology varies between the three simulations but is consistent with the dynamically subdominant role of the magnetic field, as the disc formation is not suppressed.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：沿x轴、物理宽度为 \(0.02\) pc 的密度加权密度投影。从左到右我们将初始磁场强度变化为 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\) 和 \(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有）。所有投影对应于最终演化阶段，即当晕达到峰值密度 \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) 时。时间标注在每个面板的左下角，磁力线以品红色显示。在亚pc尺度上存在盘状结构，其中最强初始磁场情况显示出最清晰的盘状特征。三个模拟之间的形态有所不同，但与磁场在动力学上起次要作用一致，因为盘的形成并未被抑制。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of magnetic field strength, magnetic field amplification \(B/\rho^{2/3}\) and the magnetic-to-kinetic energy ratio \(E_{B}/E_{K}\) when reaching three different peak densities. Black lines are for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G] (proper), pink lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G] (proper), and purple lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). Solid lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) , dashed lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) and dotted lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . The magnetic field is amplified beyond what is expected from pure spherical compression in all three simulations, though it never becomes dynamically relevant, with \(E_{B}/E_{K}\ll 1\) throughout the halo. All three cases converge to similar central field strengths of \(B\sim 10^{-2}\) G by the latest evolutionary stage.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：达到三个不同峰值密度时的质量加权球面分箱径向磁场强度、磁场放大 \(B/\rho^{2/3}\) 以及磁能与动能比 \(E_{B}/E_{K}\) 剖面。黑线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G]（固有）的运行，粉线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G]（固有）的运行，紫线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]（固有）的运行。实线对应 \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，虚线对应 \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，点线对应 \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)。在所有三个模拟中，磁场被放大到超出纯球面压缩所预期的程度，尽管它从未变得动力学相关，整个晕中 \(E_{B}/E_{K}\ll 1\)。到最新演化阶段，所有三种情况都收敛到相似的中心场强 \(B\sim 10^{-2}\) G。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Density-weighted projection of magnetic field magnitude along the y-axis at four different spatial scales. From top to bottom the physical width was varied using 100, 10, 1 and 0.1 pc, and from left to right we varied the initial magnetic field strength to \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). All projections correspond to the final evolutionary stage i.e. when the halo reaches a peak density of \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Times are indicated in the bottom left of each panel, and magnetic field lines are shown in white. The magnetic field distribution closely follows the density structure at all spatial scales, with all three cases showing comparable field strengths in the central region. A diagonal structure is visible at \(100\) pc which may trace the interface between two of the converging cold flows.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：沿y轴在四个不同空间尺度上的磁场大小密度加权投影。从上到下，物理宽度分别使用100、10、1和0.1 pc，从左到右我们将初始磁场强度变化为 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\) 和 \(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有）。所有投影对应于最终演化阶段，即当晕达到峰值密度 \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) 时。时间标注在每个面板的左下角，磁力线以白色显示。磁场分布在所有空间尺度上紧密跟随密度结构，所有三种情况在中心区域显示出可比的场强。在 \(100\) pc 处可见一个对角结构，这可能追踪两个汇聚冷流之间的界面。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of magnetic Jeans mass (solid lines), thermal Jeans mass (dashed lines) and turbulent Jeans mass (dotted lines). Each panel represents different evolutionary stages of the halo that means that the peak density is varied. Colours follow the same convention as previous figures where black lines are for simulations with a proper initial magnetic field strength of \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G], pink lines for simulations with \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G], and purple lines for simulations with \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]. The turbulent Jeans mass dominates over both thermal and magnetic contributions reaching \(\sim 10^{4}\) M ⊙ in the central regions. Magnetic pressure provides only a minor contribution in a limited radial range, confirming that the characteristic mass scale for collapse is set by turbulence rather than by magnetic fields.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：磁金斯质量（实线）、热金斯质量（虚线）和湍流金斯质量（点线）的质量加权球面分箱径向剖面。每个面板代表晕的不同演化阶段，即峰值密度变化。颜色遵循与之前图相同的约定，其中黑线对应固有初始磁场强度为 \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G] 的模拟，粉线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G] 的模拟，紫线对应 \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G] 的模拟。湍流金斯质量主导于热贡献和磁贡献，在中心区域达到 \(\sim 10^{4}\) M ⊙。磁压仅在有限的径向范围内提供次要贡献，证实坍缩的特征质量尺度由湍流而非磁场设定。
